# Squish

> Squish is a free, privacy-focused image compression tool for writers and developers. It compresses PNG, JPEG, and WebP images instantly in the browser with a live before/after comparison slider — no account, no uploads, and no server. All processing happens locally on the user's device, so images never leave the browser.

Squish is an open-source web application built with Nuxt 4 and published by the Illinois Criminal Justice Information Authority (ICJIA). Images are processed client-side with the HTML5 Canvas API; the original files are never modified and are never transmitted anywhere.

## How it works

- Drop or select PNG, JPEG, or WebP images (or load a sample image to try it).
- Adjust the quality slider (10–100%); color-coded guidance flags when quality may suffer.
- Drag the comparison slider to inspect original vs. compressed side by side; scroll to zoom (100–800%) and drag to pan.
- Download images individually or all at once, with file sizes and savings shown inline.

## Features

- Client-side compression for PNG, JPEG, and WebP — images never leave the device
- Live before/after comparison slider with zoom and pan
- Adjustable quality with real-time size and savings stats
- Batch processing with individual or bulk download
- Dark, responsive, WCAG 2.1 AA-accessible interface
